ei.title: 이익 그 이상의 가치: 트리플 보텀 라인
ei.subject: 수능특강Light

fullPassage: It is common for managers to make decisions while paying attention to what accountants call the "bottom line" — that is, considering how the decision will affect the profitability of the firm. But more and more today, we talk about the triple bottom line — a concept that focuses on a firm's economic, social, and environmental performance. Some call this triple bottom line the concern for the "3 P's" — profit, people, and planet. You might think of it more generally as acting with a sense of corporate social responsibility. And, by the way, that's most likely how you'd like your future employers to behave. "Students nowadays want to work for companies that help enhance the quality of life in their surrounding community," says one observer. And in one survey, 70% of students report that "a company's reputation and ethics" was "very important" when deciding whether or not to accept a job offer; in another survey, 79% of 13-25 year olds say they "want to work for a company that cares about how it affects or contributes to society."

questions.passage: It is common for managers to make decisions while paying attention to what accountants call the "bottom line" — that is, considering how the decision will affect the (A)[profitability / popularity] of the firm. But more and more today, we talk about the triple bottom line — a concept that focuses on a firm's economic, social, and (B)[environmental / experimental] performance. Some call this triple bottom line the concern for the "3 P's" — profit, people, and planet. You might think of it more generally as acting with a sense of corporate social responsibility. And, by the way, that's most likely how you'd like your future employers to behave. "Students nowadays want to work for companies that help (C)[enhance / diminish] the quality of life in their surrounding community," says one observer. And in one survey, 70% of students report that "a company's reputation and ethics" was "very important" when deciding whether or not to accept a job offer; in another survey, 79% of 13-25 year olds say they "want to work for a company that cares about how it affects or contributes to society."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 관리자들은 결정이 회사의 '수익성'에 어떻게 영향을 미칠지 고려한다. 트리플 보텀 라인은 경제적, 사회적, '환경적' 성과에 초점을 맞춘다. 학생들은 지역사회의 삶의 질을 '향상시키는' 기업에서 일하고 싶어 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① popularity(인기)는 원문 profitability(수익성)와 불일치
❌ ② experimental(실험적인)은 원문 environmental(환경적인)과 불일치
❌ ③ diminish(줄이다)는 원문 enhance(향상시키다)의 반의어
✅ ④ profitability — environmental — enhance: 원문 일치 ←정답

And in one survey, 70% of students report that "a company's reputation and ethics" was "very important" when deciding whether or not to accept a job offer; in another survey, 79% of 13-25 year olds say they "want to work for a company that cares about how it affects or contributes to society."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>enhance</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: enhance(향상시키다) ↔ worsen(악화시키다).
det.analysis:
❌ ① strengthen(강화하다): enhance의 유의어
❌ ② promote(촉진하다): enhance의 유의어
❌ ③ sustain(유지하다): 의미축이 다름
✅ ④ worsen(악화시키다): enhance의 반의어로 가장 적절 ←정답

questions.passage:
(A) The mattress was too <u>firm</u> for comfortable sleep. She preferred a softer surface to rest on at night.

(B) The triple bottom line focuses on a <u>firm</u>'s economic, social, and environmental performance. Many modern companies now consider their impact on society.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 firm의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A)의 firm은 형용사로 '단단한(hard/solid)', (B)의 firm은 명사로 '회사(company)'.
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 단단한 — (B) 회사: (A)는 firm mattress(단단한 매트리스), (B)는 a firm's performance(회사의 성과) ←정답
❌ ② (A) 회사 — (B) 단단한: 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ (B)가 '확고한'이 아니라 '회사'
❌ ④ (A)가 '회사'가 아니라 '단단한'
det.tip: firm: 형용사 '단단한/확고한', 명사 '회사'. 문맥으로 품사 구분

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the state of making money or gaining financial benefit"

det.korean: profitability = 수익성 (돈을 벌거나 재정적 이익을 얻는 상태)
det.analysis:
✅ ① profitability(수익성): 돈을 벌거나 재정적 이익을 얻는 상태라는 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ② community(지역사회): 무관
❌ ③ performance(성과): 넓은 의미로 재정 이익에 한정되지 않음
❌ ④ responsibility(책임): 사회적 의무이지 재정적 이익과 무관

questions.passage: It is common for managers to make decisions while paying attention to what accountants call the "bottom line" — that is, __________ (consider) how the decision will affect the profitability of the firm.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

consider → ____

det.korean: 관리자들은 결정이 회사의 수익성에 어떻게 영향을 미칠지 '고려하면서' 결정을 내린다.
det.analysis: that is 뒤에서 앞의 paying attention to를 부연 설명하는 분사구문. 동시 동작을 나타내는 현재분사 considering이 필요. that is, considering... = 즉, 고려하면서.
det.tip: consider의 현재분사 considering. 'that is'는 앞 내용의 재진술(부연) 표현

questions.passage: You might think of it more __________ (general) as acting with a sense of corporate social responsibility.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

general → ____

det.korean: 당신은 그것을 더 '일반적으로' 기업의 사회적 책임 의식으로 행동하는 것이라고 생각할 수 있다.
det.analysis: more 뒤 + 동사 think 수식 위치. 형용사 general을 부사 generally로 변환. more generally = 더 일반적으로 (동사 think를 수식).
det.tip: general(형용사) → generally(부사). 동사 수식에는 부사 필요

questions.passage: It is common for managers to make decisions while paying attention to what accountants call the "bottom line" — that is, considering how the decision will affect the profitability of the firm. But more and more today, we talk about the triple bottom line — a concept that focuses on a firm's economic, social, and environmental performance. Some call this triple bottom line the concern for the "3 P's" — profit, people, and planet. You might think of it more generally as acting with a sense of __________. And, by the way, that's most likely how you'd like your future employers to behave. "Students nowadays want to work for companies that help enhance the quality of life in their surrounding community," says one observer. And in one survey, 70% of students report that "a company's reputation and ethics" was "very important" when deciding whether or not to accept a job offer; in another survey, 79% of 13-25 year olds say they "want to work for a company that cares about how it affects or contributes to society."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 기업의 사회적 책임(corporate social responsibility). '3 P's'를 더 일반적으로 기업의 사회적 책임 의식으로 행동하는 것이라 생각할 수 있다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
❌ ① triple bottom line(트리플 보텀 라인): 앞 문장에서 이미 나온 개념이지, 'acting with a sense of'로 연결되는 태도 표현은 아님
✅ ② corporate social responsibility(기업의 사회적 책임): 원문 표현으로 트리플 보텀 라인의 일반적 명칭 ←정답
❌ ③ environmental performance(환경적 성과): 세 축 중 하나일 뿐 전체를 아우르는 개념이 아님
❌ ④ economic profitability(경제적 수익성): 세 축 중 하나일 뿐 전체를 아우르는 개념이 아님
det.tip: corporate social responsibility(CSR) = 기업의 사회적 책임 (트리플 보텀 라인의 핵심 개념)

questions.passage: It is common for managers to make decisions while paying attention to what accountants call the "bottom line" — that is, considering how the decision will affect the profitability of the firm. But more and more today, we talk about the triple bottom line — a concept that focuses on a firm's economic, social, and environmental performance. Some call this triple bottom line the concern for the "3 P's" — profit, people, and planet. You might think of it more generally as acting with a sense of corporate social responsibility. And, by the way, that's most likely how you'd like your future employers to behave. "Students nowadays want to work for companies that help enhance the quality of life in their surrounding community," says one observer. And in one survey, 70% of students report that "a company's reputation and ethics" was "very important" when deciding whether or not to accept a job offer; in another survey, 79% of 13-25 year olds say they "want to work for a company that cares about how it affects or __________ society."
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 기여하다(contributes to). 젊은이들이 사회에 어떻게 영향을 미치거나 '기여하는지'를 중시하는 기업에서 일하고 싶어 한다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ① contributes to(~에 기여하다): affects or contributes to society 원문 표현 ←정답
❌ ② pays attention to(~에 주의를 기울이다): 글 도입부의 관리자 행동이지 기업이 사회에 하는 행위가 아님
❌ ③ focuses on(~에 초점을 맞추다): 글 중간의 트리플 보텀 라인 설명에 쓰이는 표현으로 이 문맥과 불일치
❌ ④ talks about(~에 대해 이야기하다): 글 앞부분의 표현으로 기업이 사회에 하는 구체적 행위가 아님
det.tip: contribute to = ~에 기여하다 (affect와 함께 사회에 대한 영향을 나타냄)
